macros.name: acro
macros.doc: marks an acronym in normal form.

macros.name: Acro
macros.doc: marks an acronym in emphasized form.

macros.name: acroexpand
macros.doc: print the expanded form (that is the term) of an acronym, if defined. The optional first parameter is prepended only on success.

macros.name: acroindexstyle
macros.doc: print an acronym as index entry.

macros.name: aterm
macros.doc: \tacro and \aterm mark a term together with its acronym or vice versa.

macros.name: tacro
macros.doc: \tacro and \aterm mark a term together with its acronym or vice versa.

macros.name: term
macros.doc: marks a term in normal form.
